svg.title: Protein diffusion conditioning trunk architecture diagram
svg.desc: Inventory and relationships: left-to-right pipeline begins with Input text feeding a rounded gray Conditioning Trunk frame, then feature tensors frame containing two token-like sequences and a residue-pair matrix, then sequence/structure embedding frame with colored point cloud and an amino-acid sequence label. These feed the large Diffusion Module frame. Inside it, a Feature Extractor origin sends arrows to Atom-level and Residue-level Representations, which connect to Structure Denoising and Sequence Denoising heads. Output arrow leads to an intermediate denoised protein/sequence frame, then to a Final Result protein/sequence frame. A top and bottom loop indicate diffusion iterations. Symmetry/equipartition basis: the figure is arranged on a common horizontal pipeline centerline with vertically paired representation/denoising boxes inside the diffusion module and two similarly sized output frames.
